meaning: Explicit node and project instantiation entry points project the shared checked compiler plan into exact local output without treating a detached decoded node as whole-project semantic context.
node_api: planInstantiation accepts a qualified selector string and a registered reconciled project plan as its fifth argument. The plan carries the explicit authored selection and complete checked project. Language and optional numeric realization must agree; system-integration overlays reject. A detached decoded node is not a selected compiler context. Legacy decoded-node calls without the fifth argument remain unchanged.
project_api: planProjectInstantiation accepts an authored compilation selection as its third argument. A single distinct TypeScript language is required. Selection and language validation precede source access; source planning uses the common compiler and its final source-currentness check. Omission preserves legacy multi-language behavior.
views: Node views contain exactly the qualified owner modules and their transitive native imports, with unchanged artifact bytes. Whole-project views contain the common deduplicated artifact set. Both retain whole-project semantic checking, shared source/capsule identity and exact output/view receipts.
wrappers: Distinct node and project scope types use one immutable registered instantiation wrapper. Its digest binds the adapter definition, checked project, scope, exact view and receipt. Publication accepts only a registered wrapper of the matching scope. Clones, tampering, wrong scopes, foreign schemas and attempts to disguise selected wrappers as legacy plans reject before output mutation.
commands: The existing selected instantiate and instantiate-project CLI paths call these public APIs and publishers. There is no additional generation path, command default change, implicit filesystem reload for node planning, or assurance claim.
compatibility: The old plan and publication types remain distinct. Currentness receipts are not legacy conformance receipts. The source capsule, generated module layout, numeric semantics and approved Workflow behaviors remain unchanged.
non_effects: node-local checking substituted for whole-project checking
